buildResources.purpose: The single document the browser loads; every other build resource is reached from it.
The bundled application and the helper that registers the service worker.
The bundled styles, including the font faces the shell declares.
The typefaces the instance serves itself so that no browser reaches a font host.
The licence texts the bundled typefaces require to travel with them, which is why the path is readable without a session.
The installable application's fallback icon, used when a club configures no logo.
The generated service worker and its precache manifest.
The runtime the generated service worker imports.

servedResources.purpose: The installable application's club-specific metadata, generated from the configuration rather than built, so the Vite output cannot carry it.
The aggregate readiness a container runtime and an uptime check read. Details stay off this response; the group names are the only structure it discloses.

conditionalResources.purpose: The scrape endpoint a metrics collector reads. Three switches have to agree before it answers, and the permit is the third, so it is anonymous wherever they do. The reference deployment sets none. The performance profile sets all three and moves the management port; the assessment profile sets all three, but its proxy answers every /actuator path with 404 over internal networks only.

reviewedOrigins.purpose: The XML namespace names the renderer passes to createElementNS for SVG, MathML and xlink attributes, and the one the icon declares.
The prefix of the error-decoder link a production React build puts into a thrown message.
A documentation link inside a router assertion message.
A documentation link inside a translation-hook assertion message.
The shortened documentation link the precache runtime writes to the console when an entry carries no revision.
The typeface projects the bundled licence texts attribute.
The Open Font License the bundled licence texts cite.
The base a router falls back to when it constructs a URL and the document has no usable origin. It is a parser base, never a request target.

credentialPatterns.purpose: A key the deployment generates could reach the build through an environment file that a bundler inlines.
The one long-lived cloud credential form with a fixed prefix, and the one a backup target would introduce.
The token a release or documentation workflow holds, which is the credential closest to this build's own tooling.

disclosureMarkers.purpose: A reference that names an original source file even when the map itself is absent.
A note that tells a reader which part of the application its authors consider unfinished.
The directory layout of the machine that produced the build.
